subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) By the time he was twenty five years old, he had become well-known as a writer of great talent. (b) When he was a small boy his father was sent to prison for debt. (c) Dickens died in June 9, 1870. (d) He wrote some of the best novels in English literature. (e) He never forgot his hard experience of his boyhood. (f) Dickns had to work in a factory at the age of twelve. He could not go to school and receive education. (g) Even during his life time, he was exceptionally popular. (h) Charles Dickens was one of the greatest English novelists of the 19th century. He was born in February 7, 1812 in Portsmouth.
guide_solution: h → b → f → e → a → g → d →c 14
